name: Git Workflow Baseline
summary: Keep branch integration recoverable, explicit, and backed by fresh repository evidence.
description: An always-on generated context for branch isolation, integration evidence, protected branches, and commit-secret safety. Its prose is selected from catalog artifacts through machine-readable rule provenance.
risk_reason: This context keeps branch integration recoverable, explicit, and backed by fresh repository evidence; it supplies guidance without tool or approval authority.
refuses: It does not authorize commits, pushes, merges, rebases, branch deletion, or worktree removal.
It does not treat local test success as proof that remote integration or publication happened.
It does not weaken protected-branch or secret-scanning hooks when their policy blocks an operation.

rules.text: Do not commit to, push to, or rewrite a protected branch; work on a separate branch.
Do not bypass, suppress, or allowlist the commit secret guard; remove the secret from the commit instead.

operational.latency_reason: The runtime loads static guidance to keep branch integration recoverable, explicit, and backed by fresh repository evidence in the matching file scope.
